FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1
LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO
LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T31 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T31.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO SUBT2 ON SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T31.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T6 ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T6.COUNTER_ID WHERE T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPETRD08} and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and t1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND T1.PS = #{PS_T01} AND T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IS NULL AND SUBT2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN (#{PST22}, #{PST23}) AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF03}) and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and TPD.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID ) AND T1.TRADE_ID = #{finprodId}
